reels.caption:
📍The Arctic Treehouse Hotel, Rovaniemi, Finnish Lapland

You can see why the rooms are called nests. 💕Every "nest" faces north so if you are lucky enough to be there when the Northern Lights are shining, all you need do is peep out your window.

Dinner was superb at @rakasrestaurant and the reindeer tartare was incredible! Highly recommend the cloudberry tiramisu as well.

If you're coming for the Northern Lights they do appear from late August to beginning of April - but the sky was cloudy while we stayed so no auroras this time. Interestingly the best time to visit is not necessarily mid winter - because the snow often makes for cloudy skies and you need a clear night. Spring and autumn can be the best for lights viewing. In March there will be still snow on the ground for that wintery atmosphere, although I quite love the greenery before the snow. Fairies must surely live in that undergrowth.

Anyway, we loved our night here in Rovaniemi and WISHED we could stay longer.

Would you travel to Lapland to stay here?
